items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for the six zero-spend, reversible routing-only repairs; blocked for public launch, monetization expansion, analytics activation, and production exposure. Evidence supports metadata-only scope with no change to site behavior, credentials, configuration, dependencies, telemetry, schedules, domains, or spending. Compliance remains technical-only at 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown; operations and fleet-doctor evidence are unavailable; AI-usage coverage is incomplete; affiliate reporting includes $5.20 aggregate unattributed commission. Exact decision: retain all six routing repairs only if focused validation confirms exact installed-owner alignment, canonical task cleanliness, no duplication, and rollback metadata. Do not treat routing acceptance as delivery, revenue, ROI, causal lift, security clearance, or launch readiness. SearchWoot remains private pending rights, privacy, security, accuracy, measurement, counsel, and owner gates.

Launch-readiness tracking progress: 0 of 4 SearchWoot legal tasks are evidenced complete; keep all four open. Source-rights evidence confirms API access but not public redistribution, storage, derivatives, display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; human counsel is required. Next evidence action: attach one read-only bundle containing the repository data-flow/retention table, consent and GA4 configuration capture, log/vendor inventory, and deletion/correction/notification workflow; prepare but do not send the Woot permission request pending owner authorization and counsel review.
